title: Send a brief | 3Def Creative
description: Send 3Def Creative a brief for product animation, hero visuals or a launch film. Tell us about the product and where it will run.
heading: Send a brief
intro: Tell us about the product. We'll reply within a working day.[TODO: confirm reply-time promise]

form.success: Thanks, your brief is in. We'll reply to {email} within a working day.[TODO: confirm reply-time promise]
form.privacy: [TODO: confirm privacy wording]We use these details only to reply to your brief and plan the project. We don't add you to a mailing list or share your details.

next.heading: What happens next
next.text: [TODO: confirm what happens after a brief arrives]We read your brief and reply with questions or a short call suggestion. Then we send a quote with a timeline and review dates. Once you approve it, we start on the concept.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: [TODO: confirm real timeframes]Hero visuals usually take one to two weeks. A short product spot takes two to four weeks, and a launch film is scheduled with you from the brief. Deadlines that are tighter than this are sometimes possible, so ask.

[TODO: confirm revision policy]The quote includes a set number of revision rounds, with checkpoints at concept and at first animation. Changes are easiest at those points. Extra rounds beyond the quote are priced in advance.

items.q: Who supplies the 3D model of the product?
items.a: [TODO: confirm modelling policy]If you have CAD or 3D files, send them and we'll prepare them for rendering. If not, we model the product from photos, drawings or a physical sample. Modelling time is included in the quote.
[TODO: confirm delivery formats]Video as MP4 (H.264 or H.265) or ProRes, in the aspect ratios each channel needs, such as 16:9, 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1. Stills as high-resolution PNG or JPG.
[TODO: confirm pricing approach]Each project is quoted on its scope: the number of shots or stills, the length, the modelling needed and the deadline. You get a fixed quote before work starts.
